# Vendored copy of the J-F data-load subject, from pumllint's recreation experiment

| | |
|---|---|
| source repository | `fdurieux/pumllint` (the experiment's home; synthetic content, no bank data) |
| commit | `be737dd5c5d3b3dd382e01f0655b8f0317304afe` — "Merge pull request #266 from fdurieux/claude/compassionate-hamilton-ohj8mj", 2026-11-02 |
| tag | `v0.35.0` — the platform reads the tag; the commit is what it resolves to |
| what is copied | the record (`docs/recreate-experiment.md`, the pre-registration), the kit (`recreate_experiment/kit`: requirements, contracts, DMN, diagrams, the tagged Gherkin suite with its fixtures), the reference code (the codex rebuild of 2026-10-24, `src/jef`, `deploy/daily.sh` and its harness adapter), and the degradation test's pre-registration with its plant patches and gate readouts; nothing else, and never J-F's own code |
| files | 242 |
| copied | 2026-11-02, byte for byte, generated by `tools/vendor_subject.py` from a clean checkout at that commit |

pumllint's relative layout is kept under this directory so the kit's own path logic
(`features/`, `contracts/`, `MANIFEST.sha256`) and the record's paths stay valid. The
documents under `recreate_experiment/kit` are the subject the harness loads and the arms
read; the rebuild under `recreate_experiment/rebuilds/codex-2026-10-24` stands in for
J-F's private original as the code the kit's suite verified (258/258); the patches under
`recreate_experiment/degradation-2026-10-28/plant/patches` are the plants of the
subject's scenarios. Nothing here is written by a run: the platform's runs land under
`runs/`. This table is the record of which bytes the platform carries. To refresh it,
check pumllint out at the tag you want and run
`python tools/vendor_subject.py <checkout> --subject jef_data_load`, which rewrites this
file; `tests/test_vendor_subject.py` holds every file to its digest.
